mcp-search.eventDescription: Charged once per semantic search over the curated promo catalog (search_promos).

mcp-filter.eventDescription: Charged once per structured filter query (filter_promos) over provider/offer metadata.

mcp-get-promo.eventDescription: Charged once per single promo detail lookup (get_promo) with full terms and claim steps.

mcp-list-providers.eventDescription: Charged once per provider list request (list_providers).

mcp-what-can-i-get.eventDescription: Charged once per personalized recommendation (what_can_i_get), which runs the actionability engine.

mcp-initialize.eventDescription: Free. Agents can discover the server without cost.

mcp-list-tools.eventDescription: Free. Tool discovery stays free so agents can inspect capabilities.

mcp-report-issue.eventDescription: Free. Community corrections improve catalog accuracy.
